reasoning: The question asks whether a vaccine for Group A streptococcal infection will be developed by 2025-11-02 according to Wikipedia. The evidence shows that as of September 2025, a human-challenge trial for a Strep A vaccine is underway in Australia, but no vaccine has been approved or developed yet. The trial is described as accelerating research, not as a completed vaccine. All other evidence discusses pneumococcal vaccines (different disease), not Group A streptococcal vaccines. With only ~17 days remaining until the resolution date and no indication of imminent vaccine approval, it is highly unlikely that a vaccine will be developed and documented on Wikipedia by then.
